ai_only_critical_catches: Unbalanced post-QC sample sizes across conditions (n=290 in TCR vs. n=354 in CTRL, an 18% sample size reduction) directly confounding the binary FDR-thresholded claim that TCR stimulation causes a biological loss of cis-eQTLs (1,011 modules vs. 1,196–1,275)

Circular covariate optimization: selecting 29 to 38 expression principal components per condition specifically to maximize the number of discovered cis-eGenes without reporting the exact number of PCs removed per condition

Subjective manual tuning of GWAS locus window boundaries (_a, _b modified suffixes in S9 Data) and reliance on unadjusted nominal permutation p-values (p < 0.05) without multiple-testing correction across hundreds of tested locus-condition-gene pairs

Repeated immunological terminology error referring to activating anti-CD3/anti-CD28 antibodies as a 'TCR antagonist' instead of a TCR agonist throughout the Abstract, Introduction, Discussion, and Methods

Internal numerical contradictions: conflicting reQTL percentages (55.8% of 8,401 vs. 56% of 7,723 in Results vs. 72.9% in Discussion), the three scenario percentages summing to 91.9% (2.6% + 72.8% + 16.5%) instead of 100%, PHETA1 listed as a colocalized RA candidate in Table 1 despite a non-significant (NS) p-value, and S9 Fig caption mislabeling AJ009632.2 instead of PLCL1

human_substantive_critiques.issue: The non-monotonic downturn in adaptation speed and the exponential fit of ancestral growth rate vs. mutation rate rely entirely on a single extreme outlier double-mutant strain (LQ, delta-mutL delta-dnaQ), whose severe baseline growth defect likely reflects synthetic DNA replication/MMR stress rather than mutation rate alone

Confounding by distinct mutational spectra across DNA repair knockouts (e.g., AT->CG transversions in delta-mutT vs. transitions in MMR mutants) and request for whole-genome sequencing of evolved antibiotic-resistant lineages
Exclusion of insertions and deletions (indels) from baseline mutation rate estimates
Unrealistic model assumption that log-MIC increases linearly and without bound with each mutation (b_i = b_0 + i*epsilon) without diminishing returns or saturation
Speculative and biologically weakly grounded correlation between inferred mutational benefit epsilon and antibiotic molecular weight across only 5 drugs
Misinterpretation of prior literature regarding MMR hyperactivation vs. Pol III processivity in delta-mutL growth defects

ai_only_critical_catches: Deterministic continuous ODE formulation (Eq. 1) allows fractional cells (M_i << 1 cell, OD620 < 1.5e-9) to instantaneously populate multi-mutant compartments at t > 0 and survive 100-fold serial dilutions, failing to capture stochastic waiting times for discrete beneficial mutations or finite-population Muller's ratchet in 2e5-cell bottlenecks

Unreported numerical value and structural non-identifiability of the beneficial mutation fraction parameter alpha (p_b = alpha * p), which is collinear with epsilon and beta in the deterministic ODE trajectory

Pseudoreplication in the Mann-Whitney U-test (p < 0.01) comparing strain LQ (n=4 technical replicates of 1 genotype) against 5 distinct genotypes pooled as n=20 independent observations, and underpowered classification of bacteriostatic (n=2 drugs) vs. bactericidal (n=3 drugs) classes

ai_only_critical_catches: Table 1 mathematical impossibility: for 'Time (days) between booster at month 12 and last antibody measure', the reported median (29) lies strictly outside its own interquartile range ([34 - 46])

Unexplained selective attrition at M13 (only n=68 evaluated for HBV vs. n=81-82 for the other four valences) and uncentralized serology across 5 centers mixing incompatible poliovirus neutralization vs. ELISA units (1/8 dilution vs. 0.5 IU/mL)

Contradiction between the 2-way Venn diagram in Fig 1A (887 DEGs intersected with 543 ADCP genes = 9 genes) and the Methods text claiming the 9 genes came from intersecting the 181 TCGA univariate Cox survival genes with the 543 ADCP genes, plus Fig 1B-C captions falsely claiming to display 'normal tissues' in GSE46517 and GSE7553
